Path.name: Path
Path.description: 🧭 Who are you this year? Your Path decides your life at the start: school, a faculty post, an agency, the streets or the League. Every later step adjusts to it.

subcategories.name: U.A. students
subcategories.description: 🎓 U.A. Academy: its students and its teachers.

Quirk Type.name: Quirk Type
Quirk Type.description:
⚡ How your Quirk shows: Emitter (you put something out), Transformation (your body changes when you activate it), Mutant (your body is always different) or Quirkless (about one person in five).

Quirkless? Pick "No Quirk", "No Drawback (Quirkless)" and "No Quirk Strength (Quirkless)" in the next three groups.

Quirk Family.name: Quirk Family
Quirk Family.description:
🔥 What your Quirk does. Each family gives Quirk skills, two starting techniques and a path of nine techniques to learn.

Pick a family that fits your Quirk Type; if they disagree, the family's own type wins.

subcategories.name: Custom Quirk
subcategories.description: ✍️ Design your own Quirk (single player only). Two steps: describe it in your background, then once the game starts ask the in-game Studio to build its abilities; it starts with none.

subcategories.name: Canon Quirks
subcategories.description: 🎬 Quirks from the show: the same Quirk a canon character has, as your own (you are not related to them).

subcategories.name: Fusion Quirks
subcategories.description: 🧬 Two parents' Quirks fused into one Quirk: techniques from both natures, plus some only the fusion has.

Quirk Drawback.name: Quirk Drawback
Quirk Drawback.description:
⚠️ What your Quirk costs you when you push it. Quirk Strain rises as you use your Quirk: the drawback shows at 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk), bites at 80 and stops your Quirk at 100.

🎬 Canon Quirks come with their canon Drawback built in, so they skip this step.

Quirk Strength.name: Quirk Strength
Quirk Strength.description: 📈 How strong your Quirk is right now. Stronger Quirks hit harder and strain faster.

Quirk Inheritance.name: Quirk Inheritance
Quirk Inheritance.description: 🧬 One Quirk, or more? Most people have one (a Fusion Quirk, from the Fusion Quirks section of Quirk Family, is still one Quirk). All For One's Gift means extra Quirks forced into your body (villains and vigilantes).

Gifted Quirks.name: Gifted Quirks
Gifted Quirks.description: 💀 One or two extra Quirks in your body. Only with All For One's Gift. Each one you use at the same time raises your Quirk Strain.

Vigilante Past.name: Vigilante Past
Vigilante Past.description: 🌙 How you came to the streets. Vigilantes only.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: 🗾 Where you grew up: your accent, your local knowledge and who you know there.

School Days.name: School Days
School Days.description: 📓 Your high school years: the routine and habits that shaped what you are good at.

Fighting Style.name: Fighting Style
Fighting Style.description: 🥋 How you fight, or how you stay out of fights.

Skills Studied.name: Skills Studied
Skills Studied.description: 📚 Two things you studied before the story begins. Each gives +15 to that skill.

Personal Traits.name: Personal Traits
Personal Traits.description: 💬 Two sides of your personality, each with a small edge.

subcategories.name: Everyday
subcategories.description: 🌱 Everyday: who you are on an ordinary day.

subcategories.name: Heroic
subcategories.description: 🦸 Heroic: the hero's temperament. Open to every Path.

subcategories.name: Villainous
subcategories.description: 🦹 Villainous: the villain's temperament. Open to every Path.

Motivation.name: Motivation
Motivation.description: 🎯 What you want. It shapes the chances the story offers you; it never decides for you.

Gear Set.name: Gear Set
Gear Set.description: 🎒 Extra things you carry, or none. Your path already gives your uniform or outfit.

Appearance Builder.description:
🎨 Your portrait. Pick up to 20 details across style, body, hair, eyes, outfit, scene, pose and expression; leave any group empty. Visual only: these never change your Quirk or your stats.

Skipping it gives a Hero Academy Anime waist-up portrait.
